name: Animated Shorts Maker
tagline: Makes an original vertical animated story short from code, with a moving camera, voice and an original sound mix.
delivers: A 45–70 second vertical animated MP4 and a poster frame
SCRIPT.md with sources, STYLE_BIBLE.md and reference study reports
ROUNDS.md and CHECKS.md documenting visual review and final file checks
The source and GUIDE.md for rendering and changing the story, voice, colours, camera and music
tools: Chrome or Chromium (Remotion renders in it)

brief.label: Story topic and the facts to cover
brief.example: A surprising true story about how a bridge was built

brief.label: Reference shorts you have the right to study, or a look to choose
brief.example: Links to two shorts whose pacing and look I like

brief.label: Voice, language and house rules
brief.example: My own English voice recording, no captions, quiet music

limits: Makes a 45–70 second vertical animation from code. References are studied, never copied or shipped; no AI-video clips or stock footage. Review the script before production.
